title: jlens.json
description: Which schema, variables, host functions, expected result type and context apply to which JSONata files. Keys are glob patterns, relative to the folder of jlens.json; the first matching pattern applies.

additionalProperties.description: The settings of the files that match this pattern.

schema.description: A JSON Schema of the input documents, relative to the folder of jlens.json.

variables.description: The variables the expressions are evaluated with: a JSON Schema of each value, or null when the shape is unknown. Names can start with $.

result.description: The JSON types the result of an expression is expected to have, as the conditions of a rules engine must give a boolean: a result that never has one is warned about (W0212), as is one that may have another type (W0213) or be undefined (W0214).

context.description: Check the expressions as the body of the steps of this path, such as items[]: the context is an item, and % the value of the step before, as inside items.( … ).

functions.description: The host functions the expressions are evaluated with.

name.description: The name, with or without the leading $.

params.description: Parameter names, shown by signature help.

summary.description: One-line description, shown by completion and hover.
